headline: Claude Code 2.1.327 changes auto-mode allow rules and shell startup timing, and Codex 0.170.0 adds realtime WebRTC voice.

themes.title: Permission and sandbox holes closed
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.323 and 2.1.325 close a Bash `rm` check that could be skipped and a zstd decoding issue ([v2.1.323](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.323), [v2.1.325](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.325)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.7 to 1.5.9 close a hook path that could skip admin review, a sandbox proxy bypass, and a leak of MCP headers after a redirect ([1.5.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.7), [1.5.8](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.8), [1.5.9](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.9)). Codex 0.170.0 keeps sandbox restrictions through permission updates and child threads ([rust-v0.170.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.170.0)).
themes.so_what: update Claude Code to 2.1.327 and Antigravity CLI to 1.5.10 or later.

themes.title: Unattended runs now need explicit trust
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.325 makes scheduled tasks and `/loop` ask before running a skill with `allowed-tools` or hooks, and sandboxed Bash asks by default ([v2.1.325](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.325)). Claude Code 2.1.327 makes `claude mcp add --scope project` stop on a `.mcp.json` whose servers sit at the top level ([v2.1.327](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.327)), and Codex 0.169.0 keeps project config and MCP servers off in untrusted directories for `codex exec` unless `--trust` is passed ([rust-v0.169.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.169.0)).
themes.so_what: add `Skill(name)`, the `sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed` setting, `--trust` and `accept-edits` to unattended jobs, or they may wait for approval or lose their config.

themes.title: New defaults change sandbox and shell behavior
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.326 stops sandboxed commands from writing to some sensitive home folders by default, and Antigravity CLI 1.5.10 blocks sandboxed reads of `~/.config` by default ([v2.1.326](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.326), [1.5.10](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.10)). Claude Code 2.1.327 lets shell startup files run before a Bash command is approved ([v2.1.327](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.327)), and Antigravity CLI 1.5.7 makes Auto the default Agent Mode ([1.5.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.7)).
themes.so_what: re-check sandboxed jobs for blocked paths, and set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1` if startup files must wait for approval.

watch_next: The next stable Kilo Code release will repeat the notes of the pre-releases v7.8.28 and v7.8.30. Also check that unattended jobs still pass with the new auto-mode and `mcp add` rules.
